title: Mixed Event — Take the Best Shot! — Episode7 The Best Shot

meta.Event Outline: For Valentine's Day, Kohane hopes to buy An the chocolates she wants to try, but unfortunately, they're all sold out. Then, she learns that those chocolates are one of the prizes for a Valentine's Day photo contest being held by a makeup brand!

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, a picture of Aoyagi smiling...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, let's give it a try...
I do agree that we should be able to capture a different side of him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you think it'll turn out well, Azusawa, then I trust you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, we're short on time, so let's focus on making the most of our last attempt.

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Toya
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm still not sure how to go about doing this. Smiling on cue isn't something I do often...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know it's really hard when you're put on the spot like this. I also have trouble smiling when someone asks me to...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I want to capture you as you are, Aoyagi, so just try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Relax...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Now, the sun's peeking through nicely as it sets, so let's try to make use of it. Can you stand here for me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! Now, try giving me a smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How's this...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't say that your expression's changed much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Trying to relax is more difficult than I realized...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You may be tensing up because you're trying too hard to smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, instead of forcing out a smile, you could try thinking about some fun or happy memories from your past.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My memories...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, this method helped me learn how to smile more.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? But you're...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The truth is, when I was little, I had a lot of trouble smiling.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm also surprised. I was under the impression that all idols were good at that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm good at it now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I really did used to have a lot of trouble smiling...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then I met this idol while she was doing an event at a mall, and she asked me to join her on stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remember having so much fun dancing with her. The audience really enjoyed seeing that, which in turn made me unbelievably happy...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I had a big smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That really happened?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Now, I can't help but smile whenever I think about that moment.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I think you should try doing the same thing, Aoyagi. Try remembering a moment that really made you smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That really made me smile...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...
What about that time we went camping?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You seemed to have a lot of fun while pitching the tents and chopping vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only did we work together to accomplish various things that time, I got to experience a lot of new things.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I definitely enjoyed seeing my horizons expand.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like a really important memory.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and... I was elated after completing my very first track.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You were able to after asking Soma for advice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I remember really liking it.
It was gentle but also powerful... Like it wanted us to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was meant for my friends, so it makes me glad to hear you say that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, Aoyagi seems a little more relaxed now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You were also really happy when you heard the news that An and Shinonome weren't getting held back...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I was.
I honestly didn't know what would happen after they failed those tests...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But they studied very hard for their last finals for the year, so I was ecstatic after I heard the news that they'd passed.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(...!
He's smiling. He's really smiling.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Now's my chance...!
Focus your lens and...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of tests, I still haven't heard back from them about our most recent ones...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can only hope that they received passing scores...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Aoyagi, wait...!
Your brow's getting all wrinkled...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
S-Sorry, I couldn't help but worry...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay. If anything, I should be the one apologizing for bringing up their test scores...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the way you smiled just now felt really natural.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It did...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it was such a nice expression.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An's told me all about your team, but you're much closer than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Not only that...
I can tell that you're all working towards the same goal.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The same goal...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've managed to come this far after deciding to work towards making our collective dream a reality, experiencing new things and overcoming various obstacles...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito, Shiraishi and Azusawa...
They're all irreplaceable teammates.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, that look...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Yes! Now's my chance...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Got it, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
You got that? But I didn't really do anything...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. The fact that you can't tell what just happened is proof of how natural it was.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly. And I got you smiling just the way I wanted, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you both so much. I think this is our best one yet, and it wouldn't have been possible without either of you...!
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... We just managed to upload it in time...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All that's left is to see how it does.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right.
But I really think it's our best one, so I'm happy, win or lose.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nice work, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Ena...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Entries just closed. Did you manage to get your last one in...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, literally just now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena was worried sick that you guys wouldn't make it in time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
H-Hey...!
I just wanted us to compete on a level playing field is all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you for your concern.
Fortunately, we managed to get in a really nice photo!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, you guys sort of gave us the push we needed to take one last good one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? We did...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. The ones you took were so good that we thought we should try to do better.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, getting a shot of you in that pose felt like trying to catch lightning in a bottle again...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, we got what we wanted, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: May we see what you took?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Here, take a look.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This one also turned out really well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's like you're trying to tell the viewer something, and that mischievous look on your face is so cute.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
I did my best to come up with a fun situation.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And you succeeded.
Come to think of it, Akito also showed an uncanny talent for coming up with good poses and doodles when we took Print Stickers that one time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'd rather you didn't lump us together...
Wait a second, Print Stickers...? When did this happen?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, wait...! Sorry, please forget I ever said that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you mind showing us what you all took, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, here's our photo...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa... This looks amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it does. And your expression's so lovely, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's beautiful how the light from the sunset has this softness to it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Also...
This feels really heartwarming for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You look so happy that I can't help but smile too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can't really complain if you guys win after seeing this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, something's definitely wrong if this doesn't make it into the top ten.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we also like what we took, so I'm looking forward to seeing the final tally...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. Since we're all here, why don't we wait for the results together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They won't be out until later tonight, so we'll have to go find a place where we can sit for a while...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, let's do that!
I've been meaning to ask you guys how you took those pics.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'd like to ask you about yours as well.
We couldn't help but wonder how you were able to get them to be so eye-catching.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, there's no real trick to that. We just...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What if I...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. What a nice photo...
